candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: For both workstreams, please send me the quote along with the timeline.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
For now, let's remove the landing-page work from scope. On the creative side, the proposed price is too high, and we also do not supply raw footage or voiceover.

The successful ad I shared was produced by another freelancer for 4800/- per video. He is a subject-matter expert, but he is currently unreachable, which is why I am looking here instead.

Your scope would therefore need to cover everything: footage, voiceover, and script. Our counterproposal is 22k inr for 8 video ads, each 45sec long, delivered as 16 finished files.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: To evaluate the quality you produce, let's begin with 3 videos before expanding the scope.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Before I award the work, please provide a complete written description of everything you will do. Confirm that the ad will use actual footage and that neither an avatar nor a static image will be used to create the video. The specification should also cover every other technical step you will handle, including proper lipsync.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Because my landing page is adult-oriented, it will not be useful for this creative. We do have many customer reviews, but most came through calls, are not recorded on the site, and are generally not in a proper format. It would therefore be better for you to create the testimonial material independently. Our product mostly attracts an audience aged 28-54.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: For the initial test, how long would you need to prepare 3 videos in 2 formats? We will test these first, and if the test works, we will order 5 more.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: To correct what was lacking in the previous unsuccessful video, please ensure this one has appropriate cuts and the right audio dB level.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Please list every agreed detail in the offer, including appropriate cuts and Audio DB 18 applied according to proper standards. You can send the offer to me, and I will accept it.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Only Indian actors should appear in the video, with male actors preferred. The content also needs to have a viral style. If you believe revising the script will make it more viral, you may use the key words and change the script as you see fit.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: A fresh creative perspective is required, because the video must not feel like a copy of the winning creative. For example, you could use a testimonial-style concept featuring couples discussing the product and giving feedback, or multiple patients talking about it.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: The whole concept does not work at all. In particular, the hook is far too indirect to hold a user's attention, and this kind of approach will not work in India. Select the relevant keywords from the reference videos I sent and use them directly in the revision instead.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Please discard this entire script because the safe, indirect approach will not work. Sending the reference videos served no purpose if the result was going to take this direction. Carefully listen to and understand the 4th video and the last video I sent today, extract their key words, and rebuild the script around those.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Please follow these steps:
1\. Use the script from the last reference I sent as the foundation, since it is a good script.
2\. Identify its keywords and key message; that same message is what we want to communicate.
3\. Determine what the script lacks, remove those weak parts, and replace them with something more powerful. Your task is to improve it without adding anything generic—the wording must be unique while still delivering the same message.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Conversion performance, rather than appearance alone, must remain the priority for this Video ad. We are trying to create a high-converting ad, not merely one that looks aesthetically better.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: The keywords energy, confidence, stamina and performance are too generic, and using them will push the cpl too high; I mentioned this last time. Review the transcript of my winning video and the latest reference, then write and send the extracted keywords here. Include terms such as timing and dheelapan. The confidence and stamina wording you proposed does not work, and the complete script must be sent in Hindi only.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Although confidence and stamina can be included, they cannot be the only terms; other reference-derived keywords must be used as well. Also, please send the entire script in Hindi itself.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Instead of sending me the script first, prepare 16 sec shots so I can judge whether they work. They must be in Hindi, not english, because the script alone does not let me visualize how the result will look.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Do not use लिंग; remove that word. The product offers the same benefits as the references.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Use the last reference I sent as the model, then add relevant benefits from both my winner script and that last reference script to create something similar.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: To be honest, the 22 sec preview does not create a good impression or feel real; it is immediately obvious that it was made with AI.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: I have already sent you images for the 1st product. However, I do not have a proper image for the 2nd product, so use AI to create better pack shots for that one.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Make sure the video includes both products.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Within the next 72hrs, you must deliver this to me; I will not allow any more time, and otherwise I will have to cancel. The video also needs broadcast-ready quality, and if there are any issues, I will not pay. It has already taken 7 times the time you committed to, yet it still is not ready. This is very poor service.
